label: Part I · Foundations and the global landscape
subtitle: Two centuries of being confidently wrong about where breast cancer goes and why. Each idea is read for the error it corrected and the one it introduced.

chapters.title: Epidemiology and the changing burden of disease
Conceptual frameworks for understanding breast cancer

label: Part II · Normal biology, carcinogenesis, and inherited susceptibility
subtitle: What the normal breast does, and how much of it a tumor keeps. Precursor states come before any malignant biology, because that is the order the tissue works in.

chapters.title: Inherited susceptibility and familial breast cancer

label: Part III · Pathology and classification
subtitle: Every taxonomy in this field was built for a purpose. The useful question is not whether a classification is true but what it was built to decide.

chapters.title: Histopathology and the spectrum of breast neoplasia
Receptor assessment and the measurement problem
Triple-negative and other biologically diverse phenotypes

label: Part IV · Molecular biology and therapeutic vulnerabilities
subtitle: Organized by pathway rather than by drug. Each chapter closes on the resistance mechanisms that the metastatic chapters will have to act on.

chapters.title: Hallmarks and pathway logic in breast cancer
Estrogen receptor signaling and endocrine resistance
PI3K, AKT, mTOR, and related networks
DNA repair, replication stress, and genomic instability
Epigenetics, transcriptional control, and lineage identity

label: Part V · Immunology and the tumor microenvironment
subtitle: Compartments first, then function, then spatial arrangement, then the host. Checkpoints arrive late here on purpose.

chapters.title: Cellular architecture of the tumor microenvironment
Spatial organization and what it adds

label: Part VI · Heterogeneity, evolution, and metastatic biology
subtitle: The core of the book. It sits before the treatment chapters so that all of them can assume it, and every chapter in it separates what is biology from what is measurement.

chapters.title: Dormancy, residual disease, and late recurrence

label: Part VII · Detection, diagnosis, and biomarker assessment
subtitle: Every assay here is a sampling procedure. What it measures, what it stands in for, and how far apart those two can drift.

chapters.title: Prognostic and predictive assays and somatic profiling

label: Part VIII · Therapeutic foundations
subtitle: Modality and drug class, carried once and in full. The disease chapters cite this part instead of repeating it, which is what keeps them short.

label: Part IX · Early-stage disease: in situ, locally advanced, and the neoadjuvant platform
subtitle: Setting-level chapters. What to do about a lesion that may not need treating, about disease that presents late, and about the neoadjuvant window as an experiment rather than a schedule.

chapters.title: Locally advanced and inflammatory breast cancer
The neoadjuvant setting as a scientific platform

label: Part X · Adjuvant and neoadjuvant therapy by subtype
subtitle: The trial record for early disease, one subtype and setting at a time. Tables are generated from the registry, so a new readout lands here the moment it is entered once.

chapters.title: Adjuvant endocrine therapy in hormone receptor-positive disease
Neoadjuvant therapy in hormone receptor-positive disease
Adjuvant and post-neoadjuvant therapy in triple-negative disease
Neoadjuvant therapy in triple-negative disease including checkpoint blockade

label: Part XI · Metastatic disease: principles and cross-cutting management
subtitle: What holds across every subtype once the disease is incurable. Goals, burden, and the organ-specific problems that do not sort by receptor.

chapters.title: Expression and alteration-defined treatment across subtypes

label: Part XII · Metastatic systemic therapy by subtype and line
subtitle: The same contract for advanced disease, organised by line, because line is what the reader is choosing within. Sequencing is where the evidence runs out and the chapters say so.

chapters.title: Endocrine therapy and receptor degraders in metastatic disease
CDK4/6 inhibition in metastatic disease, combinations and sequencing
Conjugates and chemotherapy in later-line hormone receptor-positive disease
HER2-directed therapy in metastatic disease from first line onwards
Systemic therapy in metastatic triple-negative disease from first line onwards

label: Part XIII · Special populations and uncommon presentations
subtitle: The patients trials enroll least and clinics see often enough. Extrapolation is the default here, so each chapter says how far it is being stretched.

chapters.title: Sex, gender, and uncommon disease contexts

label: Part XIV · Supportive care, survivorship, and patient experience
subtitle: A full part rather than an appendix. Most of what a patient actually lives with sits here.

label: Part XV · Disparities, access, and health systems
subtitle: Biology and access are separated at every step, and race is not allowed to stand in for either.

chapters.title: Disparities across the breast cancer continuum
Implementation, policy, and quality of care

label: Part XVI · Research methods, evidence, and emerging therapy
subtitle: The part that will age fastest. Organized by mechanism rather than by agent, so that a new drug does not require a new chapter.
